## The rule
A finished edit is not a one-off — it is a skill file. The workflow is:
save the prompt once → every edit starts from the same rules → every
correction note becomes a rule in the file → the next edit needs fewer notes.
One skill per job, one folder per skill (davis.mcm: "A skill is just a
folder"); small skills beat one giant prompt (ibravisual). The skill is
invoked by one line ("Use this skill to edit it." / "/evidence-reel"), and
the same style repeats every time.

## Executable steps
1. Build the folder first (kingketo HOW I EDIT step 1 / charliehills step 2):
   one folder, raw footage + references + brand file + best edit inside.
2. Teach the style from finished work (kingketo step 4): dump in reels you
   edited and love; the skill learns captions, face framing, motion, beats.
3. Run the edit with the one-line trigger, then go back and forth a few
   times (kingketo steps 6–7): each note is a correction, given one at a time
   (charliehills step 8: "One note at a time").
4. Save it as a skill (the doctrine): paste the full prompt once and tell
   Claude to save it as `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, with the notes file
   (`notes.md` — every note, as a rule) beside it.
5. Next time, invoke by name only — no re-pasting, no re-teaching. Count the
   rules (kingketo: "35 rules and counting") — the count going up while the
   notes per edit go down is the proof the skill is learning.

## Worked example (PWC)
P1 v9 is the finished edit to beat (`best.mp4`). Save the P1 edit as a skill:
SKILL.md carries the PWC rules (teal #14A886 / gold #FEE238 on navy #00214E,
no red; captions center-lower, never over the face; word-exact Sky captions;
hook in ≤2s with Q's face on screen). Every correction Q gives on the next
P-pack take becomes a rule in `notes.md`. Next take: "Use this skill to edit
it." — one line, same style, fewer notes.

## PWC skin
Palette teal #14A886 / gold #FEE238 on navy #00214E, no red. Kingketo's
"yellow on the word I'm saying" is HIS caption colour — PWC uses gold
#FEE238 for the keyword, teal for the rest; do not adopt his yellow. His
"My face full size, never covered" maps directly onto Q's brand law (nothing
over Q's face ever) — a third source confirming it (also charliehills batch
14, kingketo batch 17). The skill file is TEXT + scripts; per SAFETY.md no
harvested skill is installed or run without a full read first, and gated /
funnel content (kingketo's "AI Editing Cheat Code" via comment EDIT) is
NEVER chased — rebuild from visible specs only, labeled INFERRED.

## Discrepancies — carried as observed, NOT reconciled
- **Cut length:** kingketo's type-one-line step settles at "Cut 4:24 down to
  2:07" (HOW I EDIT, DfKequOEQez, batch 18) vs "Cut 4:24 down to 1:12" (THE
  CLAUDE EDIT, DfKgqktkZ-j, batch 18). Within DfKgqktkZ-j itself the chat
  animates — first frame says 2:07, later frames settle on 1:12. Both
  versions agree on "132 words of restarts gone" and "Checked it: 11 of 11
  passed". Recorded as observed.
- **Style rule III:** HOW I EDIT (DfKeqt4EbyW, batch 17) lists rule III as
  "Motion that matches my voice"; THE CLAUDE EDIT (DfKgqkrEeo5, batch 18)
  lists rule III as "Music from frame 1, under my voice". Same step, same
  system, different rule III. Recorded as observed.
- **Step-count framing:** the same system is framed as "STEP X OF 5" AND
  "STEP X OF 8" inside HOW I EDIT (slides 03–05 say "OF 5", slides 07–09 say
  "OF 8"), and as "STEP I–VIII OF VIII" in THE CLAUDE EDIT. The two
  carousels are the same system re-skinned and re-numbered. Recorded as
  observed — do not force one numbering.
- **Skill-count framing:** kingketo counts "35 rules and counting";
  charliehills counts skills, not rules. Different counters, same loop.

## Variants folded (v8 — Batch 6)

- **"Mark ready to post" calendar trigger (DfH3KDijEgL)** — variant of the
  one-stack doctrine: the automation's only human action is flipping a
  status in the content calendar (IDEA TO APPROVE → POSTED); everything
  after is automation. Q's one-stack already has the same shape (a video +
  cover + caption filed by date; the post fires from the stack). Same
  doctrine in Notion form — not a separate part.
- **Per-platform optimized captions (DfH3KDijEgL)** — variant of Q's
  mirroring rule, confirmed second source: one video, different captions
  per platform (LinkedIn / Facebook / TikTok / YouTube Shorts). Q already
  runs this pattern (IG + LinkedIn mirroring; TikTok held for @yerrr__q).
  Recorded as a confirmed pattern, not a new part.
